title: Besauce Build | The Energy Machine | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Besauce is a Lightning Regen Aniimo, and its base Regen of one hundred eighteen is its best stat. Charged Geyser restores energy right away and keeps restoring it over time. Electric Dance Frenzy lowers enemy Lightning resistance for your team. Its trait Power Surge restores energy when you cast with less than twenty energy. Keep it away from Dark and Ice. Do you run Besauce? Comment below!
